chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us, he said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik narrated to me, he said: al-Hasan ibn Wahb narrated to me, he said: Isma'il ibn Abban narrated to me, from Yunus ibn Abu Ya'foor, he said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
When as-Sufyani rises, he will send an army to us and an army to you. If that takes place, come to us by any means, whether difficult or easy.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: as-Sufyani, a specific eschatological leader in Shia tradition

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the actions of as-Sufyani and how should the Shia respond?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the emergence of the Sufyani is linked to a dual-front military campaign against the Ahl al-Bayt and the Shia community, prompting a call for global mobilization. The instruction to come 'on every difficult and easy path' underscores the urgency of gathering in Kufa or Medina to support the Mahdi, reflecting the Shia tradition of waiting (Intizar) and active preparation for the final victory. This event is a pivotal sign in the eschatological timeline, emphasizing the unity of believers despite geographical and physical challenges.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (17) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Ja’far bin Muhammad bin Malik from al-Hasan bin Wahab from Issma’eel bin Abban from Younus bin Abu Ya’foor that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“When as-Sufyani rises, he will send an army to fight us (the Hashemites) and an army to fight you (the Shia). If that takes place, hurry to us by any means!”
